watch_list.summary: Lauren amplified Cursor’s rebuild of Projects for multiplayer, so teammates and their agents can work together in one workspace.
Grok Bot can now join your personal or company Tailscale tailnet to reach private MCP servers, internal tools, and apps on your network.
Lauren recommends trying Gemini 4 Carbon, now in Cursor and the top model on CursorBench at 60.4% at high effort.
Her skills use disable-model-invocation: true in the frontmatter so they are not loaded by default; pick them when needed, and /poteto-help has more info.
In his one-shot Fable game, every texture and model is a shader function rather than an image or 3D asset, and you can inspect the source in the HTML.
Asked how he guides Claude for the one-shot game, Felix said his claude.md is empty.

items.title: We Turned a Hot Sauce Into a Soap Opera | Higgsfield Drama Ads
items.summary: Higgsfield launches Drama Ads, a one-click format that turns any product into a soap-opera-style ad with organic placement, editing, captions, and sound, shown here with hot sauce.

items.title: My Friend Acted Out a Dinosaur Run for My AI Shot
items.summary: Still unhappy with a too-smooth AI dinosaur run, the creator has a friend act out a movement reference and then turns what worked into a Claude motion skill for a weightier gait.

items.title: Pro VFX Artist vs 8 Hours of AI: You Decide
items.summary: A traditional VFX dinosaur-chase cut is set against an eight-hour AI version; VFX artist Patrick Kalyn still favors the traditional work at this stage and asks viewers to choose.

items.title: AI時代最大的謊言：除了七大科技公司，根本沒人賺到錢！AI到底是不是泡沫？｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: Kelly Tsai asks whether AI is a bubble, arguing the era's biggest lie is that anyone besides the Magnificent Seven tech companies is actually making money from it.
